module: Debug drawing for the vehicle AI (spheres, cylinders, texts via obj.debugDrawProxy). Loaded by ai.lua (require 'aiDebugDraw'); ai.setVehicleDebugMode enables or disables it depending on ai.debugMode. It reads a context (ego, twt, current route, map, scriptai...) provided by ai.lua via setContextBinder, and only writes to ai.debugDraw (function called by the main loop to draw). A modder does not normally call it directly.
notes: Modes drawn according to ai.debugMode: 'target', 'route', 'speeds', 'trajectory', 'rays'. In 'script' mode with scriptai active, scriptai.debugDraw() is also called.
enable() initializes the context on the first call (via the binder), then replaces ai.debugDraw with the drawing function; disable() resets ai.debugDraw = nop.

Minor bug: in onDebugModeChanged, when the mode is not 'speeds', it is visDebug.trajecRec that is emptied (and not a buffer specific to speeds), even though this buffer is already emptied outside 'trajectory'.

setContextBinder.desc: Registers the function that will build the context (ego, twt, route/map/scriptai access, castRay...) at the first enable().

fn.desc: Function with no argument that calls aiDebugDraw.init(context).

init.desc: Stores the context used by the drawing.

context.desc: Table with ego, twt, lastCommand, player (function), getCurrentRoute, getMapData, getScriptai, roadNaturalContinuation, castRay, populateOBBinRange.

onDebugModeChanged.desc: Hook called by ai.setVehicleDebugMode when the debug mode changes: empties the drawing histories (trajectory, route) that no longer match the chosen mode.

reset.desc: Empties the drawing histories (trajectory and route). Called by ai.setMode.

enable.desc: Enables debug drawing: binds the context if necessary then puts the drawing function in ai.debugDraw.
